text:
olivia_reyes: Hey folks — I legally changed my last name to Morales after marriage and updated Workday on 2025-06-10, but my carrier still issued the insurance ID card under Reyes. I just got an ER bill from 2025-06-18 that was denied for "name mismatch". I leave for a trip on 2025-06-25 and need an updated ID card. Help?

maria_hr: Congrats Olivia! Quick checklist: updated legal name in Workday (done), marriage certificate or court docs, photo ID showing new name, and the EOB/denial letter from the carrier. We'll need scans to push to the carrier for both claim reprocessing and ID update.

olivia_reyes: I have the marriage cert and driver's license with Morales. The carrier denial PDF says Claim# 987654321 and "subscriber name does not match". Do you need the full denial PDF?

eli_benefits: Yes please attach the carrier denial/EOB and the ER itemized bill. For claim reprocessing we submit: (1) corrected subscriber info, (2) proof of name change, and (3) a signed claim reconsideration form if carrier requires it. Some carriers let employer submit a name-change update and they auto-reprocess open claims.

olivia_reyes: Where do I upload securely?

maria_hr: Use Workday > Benefits > Documents > Add Document. Tag type: "Name change / Claim docs". If upload error, send to benefits@redwood.com with subject exactly: "Name change + claim reprocess - olivia_reyes - Claim 987654321". We'll send a secure link for SSN if they ask.

eli_benefits: For the ID card rush: we can request expedited reissue. Carriers usually do digital ID in 24-48 hrs, physical card in ~5-7 business days unless overnighting is approved. If you need physical for travel, include travel dates and passport scan so we can request overnight shipping from carrier.

olivia_reyes: Travel is 2025-06-25, domestic flight. Honestly digital ID would work if it shows subscriber name Morales and policy #. How can I get a digital card ASAP?

eli_benefits: After we submit the name update, ask for a digital ID pdf/mobile card. We'll mark the request urgent and push for same-day digital delivery where possible. Sometimes carrier mobile apps reflect changes faster than mailed cards.

claims-team: For claim 987654321 we'll request reprocessing with the carrier. Steps we will take: 1) update subscriber name on carrier roster, 2) submit claim reprocess request with attached EOB & name-change docs, 3) follow up with carrier rep and escalate if necessary. Typical reprocess ETA: 7-14 business days, can be faster with escalation.

olivia_reyes: If claim stays denied will this become my responsibility? I already paid the ER copay but hospital billed 100% and balance is large.

eli_benefits: If carrier ultimately denies and it's due to admin name mismatch, our advocacy often gets partial/full reversal after reprocessing/appeal. We'll also help file an appeal on your behalf. Meanwhile save all receipts and itemized bills (superbills). If you get a balance notice, don't pay until we confirm carrier outcome — you can ask provider for a hold and explain "insurance billing in process".

maria_hr: Small doc template to include in your upload (paste into email body):

"To: benefits@redwood.com
Subject: Name change + claim reprocess - olivia_reyes - Claim 987654321

Hi Benefits,
Please update my subscriber name to Olivia Morales (formerly Olivia Reyes) and submit claim reprocessing for Claim# 987654321 (ER 2025-06-18). Attached: marriage certificate, updated driver's license, carrier EOB/denial, itemized ER bill. Travel date: 2025-06-25 — please request a digital ID and overnight physical card if carrier permits.
Thanks,
Olivia"

olivia_reyes: Done — uploaded docs to Workday and pasted that email body. Anything else I should do? :airplane:

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: #HR-86740. Assigned to eli_benefits. Expect initial carrier submission within 1 business day.

claims-team: Received intake. We'll call carrier rep after submission and request digital ID ASAP. If carrier asks for signed forms, we'll route the form to you for e-sign.

olivia_reyes: Amazing, thank you. If carrier refuses overnight physical, I'd like a dated confirmation of the digital ID for travel.

eli_benefits: Will do. We'll post an update here once carrier confirms digital ID availability or sends card tracking. If you get any more notices from provider, forward them to this thread.

people-ops-bot: Update logged: #HR-86740 - docs received and queued for carrier submission."
